concept.hr: Pretkopiranje konvergira samo ako gost prlja sporije nego što veza kopira
concept.en: Pre-copy rounds converge only if dirtying is slower than copying

summary.hr: Pomakni brzinu prljanja i propusnost veze: krugovi pretkopiranja se smanjuju ili ne, a gost na kraju stoji 41 ms ili 9 s.
summary.en: Slide the dirty rate and the link bandwidth: the pre-copy rounds shrink or they do not, and the guest is paused for 41 ms or 9 s.

title.en: The guest dirties faster than the link

concept.hr: Svaki krug ponovno šalje cijeli radni skup; pretkopiranje ne konvergira
concept.en: Every round resends the whole working set; pre-copy does not converge

concept.hr: Manje procesora gostu, sporije prljanje: seoba konvergira nakon 10 krugova
concept.en: Less CPU for the guest, slower dirtying: the migration converges after 10 rounds
